steps.prompt: Implement the specifically authorized change. Commit the result and produce a Git bundle if no shared remote is available. Report tests and full commit hash.
steps.acceptance: Review concrete diff, tests and deliverables before acceptance.

steps.prompt: Read task project-change-001-develop through fleet_status. Obtain its exact commit or artifact, review the change, and report actionable findings with file and line evidence.
steps.acceptance: Review must name the exact candidate commit and concrete findings.

steps.prompt: Read the development and review tasks. Obtain the development commit before editing. Address confirmed findings and report the tested candidate commit; if no fixes are needed, explain with evidence.
steps.acceptance: Findings resolved or explicitly justified, tests pass on identified commit.

steps.prompt: Retrieve the approved candidate commit from project-change-001-fix. Prepare a separate integration worktree. Run the project tests and report conflicts or results. Publishing or updating the main branch follows the user project policy.
steps.acceptance: Integration diff and tests inspected; record final commit and remaining blockers.
